description:
Public market numbers for one US stock or ETF.

    Returns price, day change, 52-week range, market cap and trailing
    P/E. Use this when the user asks about a specific ticker, for
    example AAPL or BRK.B. Don't use it for the user's own holdings (use
    list_portfolio) or for buy/sell decisions.

    Limits: US tickers only; data from Yahoo Finance, up to 15 minutes
    old; without sign-in there is a shared daily limit. When signed in,
    the answer also says whether the ticker is on the user's watchlist.
    Educational information, not investment advice.
name: stock_analysis
title: Analyze a Stock
